leads.title: Decree No. 9,755/2020 - State of Goiás
leads.documents: State-level guidelines defining LGBTphobic violence including discrimination, bullying, and cyberbullying; enforcement framework for anti-discrimination in Goiás.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Decree No. 9,755/2020' establishing guidelines and defining LGBTphobic violence. No URL visible.

leads.title: Goiás State Board of Education rule - 3 July 2014
leads.documents: Authorizes transgender and travesti students to use social names in schools in Goiás; documents institutional recognition of gender identity in education.
leads.detail: Cited as approved 3 July 2014 by Goiás State Board of Education. No URL visible.

leads.title: Novo Gama municipal law (2015) - restroom ban
leads.documents: 2015 city law prohibiting transgender people from using public restrooms in accordance with gender identity in Novo Gama, Goiás.
leads.detail: Cited as enacted 2015 in city of Novo Gama. No URL visible.

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court challenge to Novo Gama bathroom law - Justice Cármen Lúcia order
leads.documents: Challenge by Associação Nacional de Travestis e Transexuais (ANTRA) to Novo Gama restroom law; Justice Cármen Lúcia set deadline of 11 June 2024 for municipal government explanation.
leads.detail: Cited as ANTRA challenge prompting Justice Cármen Lúcia deadline of 11 June 2024. No URL visible.

leads.title: Court of Justice of Goiás decision - 28 August 2023 (Mar Dias case)
leads.documents: Favorable ruling authorizing document rectification for non-binary person Mar Dias after registry denial; filed via Public Defender's Office of the State of Goiás sought Feb 2020.
leads.detail: Cited as petition by Public Defender's Office of the State of Goiás, decided 28 August 2023. No URL visible.

leads.title: Goianira court and Court of Justice of Goiás decisions - Kali Julie Dias case
leads.documents: Name and gender-marker case: Goianira court authorized name change but denied gender change citing absence of specific law for non-binary recognition; Court of Justice authorized gender marker change on appeal 12 December 2025.
leads.detail: Cited as assistance sought 29 January 2025 from Public Defender's Office, lawsuit in Goianira, appeal granted 12 December 2025. No URL visible.

leads.title: Supreme Court injunction 20 February 2020 and STF plenary vote 25 April - Novo Gama 'gender ideology' teaching ban
leads.documents: Preliminary injunction by Justice Alexandre de Moraes striking down 2015 Novo Gama law banning teaching of 'gender ideology'; unanimous STF vote to strike down.
leads.detail: Cited as injunction 20 February 2020 by Alexandre de Moraes, unanimous strike-down vote on April 25. No URL visible.

leads.title: Águas Lindas de Goiás municipal law 12 December 2021 - gender-neutral language ban
leads.documents: Law signed by mayor Lucas de Carvalho Antonietti prohibiting gender-neutral language in city schools; overturned by Moraes injunction May 2024 and struck down by STF March 2026.
leads.detail: Cited as signed 12 December 2021, injunction May 2024, STF strike-down March 2026. No URL visible.

leads.title: Legislative Assembly of Goiás bill - 24 August 2022
leads.documents: State bill approved to ban discussions on sexuality and gender ('gender ideology') in Goiás state schools; status pending governor signature/veto.
leads.detail: Cited as approved 24 August 2022 by Legislative Assembly of Goiás, not yet signed or vetoed. No URL visible.

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling - 1 March 2018 on name and sex change
leads.documents: National ruling applicable in Goiás that transgender person may change official name and sex by self-declaration of psychosocial identity without surgery or professional evaluation.
leads.detail: Cited as STF ruling 1 March 2018. No URL visible.
